boundary.rulesOnly: No explanation is written, and no model is called. The findings are the rules' own words.
boundary.local: The model runs on this computer, so nothing about the review is sent anywhere. It costs time and power on this machine instead.
boundary.snoutAi: The changed SQL, and the findings taken from your database, are sent to our servers to be written up, and it comes out of your AI allowance.
boundary.ollamaLocal: The model runs on this computer, on the Ollama you are running. Nothing about the review is sent anywhere.
boundary.ollamaRemote: The changed SQL, and the findings taken from your database, are sent to the Ollama server you named ({host}). They do not reach us.
boundary.byok: The changed SQL, and the findings taken from your database, are sent to {vendor} using your own key. They do not reach us.
